other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.height:
fun height :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where
  "height Leaf = 0" |
  "height (Node l a r) = max (height l) (height r) + 1"
formal function definitions.map_tree:
primrec map_tree :: "('a ⇒ 'b) ⇒ 'a tree ⇒ 'b tree" where
  "map_tree f Leaf = Leaf" |
  "map_tree f (Node l x r) = (Node (map_tree f l) (f x) (map_tree f r))"

formal theorem statement: theorem height_map_tree[simp]: "height (map_tree f t) = height t"
